question: Could the GUI 20210609 used by Morard use a different MGD equation or numerical engine from the audited EosFit7c 7.60?
qualification: Version notes, public source history and distributed binary pressure routines support equivalent MGD evaluation. Exact original 20210609 GUI binary is unavailable: no direct original-GUI fit has been run. Public repository snapshot equality does not identify private build inputs. GUI and console refinement frontends need not be instruction-identical or select the same weights/data/defaults.

distributed_gui.qualification: Current official Mac installer, not the original author executable.

release_history.mgd_relevance: GUI MGD fitting bugs fixed. Unweighted parameter-esd bug fixed. Calculator MGD parameter editing/saving bugs fixed. All predate the author GUI banner.

Added q-compromise MGD; improved volume inversion and refinement termination. Two numerical fixes concern fourth-order linear moduli and thermal-pressure fitting to T-V-only data, unlike this volumetric BM3 P-V-T audit.

release_history.date_qualification: Bundled manual says November 2021; current website labels graphics fixes December 2021. Mac GUI binary banner is 20211014. These labels are retained separately.
release_history.mgd_relevance: Bundled manual explicitly describes the Mac re-release as identical to the summer version except for the graphics-library crash fix.
Windows 11 calculator compatibility fix; no documented changed MGD fitting law.

regression_frontend_caution.interpretation: The refinement routine differs between these programs; console also contains group-scale refinement support. Pressure-routine agreement is not proof of identical front-end fitting defaults or an empirical original-GUI regression comparison.

later_public_library_update.qualification: Later CrysFML source changes exist. They must not be assumed to be compiled into the distributed 2021 binaries used for this audit.

conclusion: No documented June-to-late-2021 numerical MGD change explains the FeS residual mismatch. A remaining GUI-specific data-selection, weighting, starting-model or refinement behavior has not been empirically ruled out using the original GUI executable.

source_history_check.command: git log --all --since=2021-06-09 --until=2021-10-15 --format=%H -- Src/CFML_EoS.f90 Src/CFML_Math_General.f90 Src/CFML_Optimization_LSQ.f90 Src/CFML_LSQ_TypeDef.f90

disassembly_qualification: otool -tvV output; remove leading instruction addresses and replace hexadecimal addresses/immediates by <address>. Equal hashes show matched normalized instruction structure. They do not prove identical constants, absolute addresses, original June GUI binary or full program behavior.
